name: Fallen Reflections
source:
Welcome! Fallen Reflections is a pixilated visual novel, where you find yourself at the same college as your childhood friend June, whom you haven’t seen face to face in years. 

Guide Mayble in a slice of life where you can make friends, and help an old one.

[From [url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/fallen-reflections-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
